angle: Name the enemy: hosting scattered across five apps, a WhatsApp thread and a spreadsheet. Resolve it in one artifact: the whole operation in one app.
brief: Post 2 of the first three @hububbhost posts (Tension resolved). One iPhone holds still on a light scene under the fixed headline while its screen cross-dissolves through six real app screens, inbox, channels, pricing, cleaning, guest portal, performance, each named by a short label pill. The headline stays constant so the one-app point lands while the product does the moving. Real screenshots, nothing invented; the caption carries the five-apps tension. pillar: relief, funnel: follow.

copy.headline: Everything a host needs. All in one app.
copy.subhead: The tools that used to live in five apps, now in one.

social.firstLine: Hosting was never meant to take five apps.
social.caption:
Hosting was never meant to take five apps.

One for messages, one for the calendar, one for pricing, a WhatsApp thread for the cleaner, and a spreadsheet holding it all together.

Hububb Host brings the whole operation into one app: inbox, channels, pricing, cleaning, guest portal and reports, with Hostie running them for you.

Less switching. Less chasing. Everything under one roof.
